about: BLS Polymers Limited manufactures multiple grades of custom formulated polymer compounds used for wire and cable insulation and 3LPE pipeline coatings. The company serves critical infrastructure industries including telecommunications, power, railways, water, and oil and gas distribution. It operates from a single manufacturing facility located in Goa and is part of the BLS Group.

objects.purpose: Financing capital expenditure requirement towards expansion of Goa Manufacturing Facility

promoters.background: Part of the BLS Group with over 3 decades of operating history across polymers, education, and digital/visa government outsourcing services.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 66.81% of Fiscal 2026 revenue, and top 5 customers accounted for 53.45%. Wire and cable segment contributed 80.93% of sales in Fiscal 2026.

litigation_note: Contingent liabilities totaled ₹9.72 crore as of March 31, 2026, including ₹8.00 crore bank guarantee to IOCL and tax appeal demands. Summons were previously issued by SEBI to group company BLS International Services Ltd.
strengths: Enlisted with prominent government agencies and CPSEs, creating significant entry barriers for competitors.
Diversified portfolio offering 6 products in 127 grades across telecommunication, power, and infrastructure sectors.
Long-standing relationships with customers, with 90.84% repeat orders over the last three fiscal years.
Pan-India market presence across 23 states and union territories, with direct sales contributing over 98% of revenue.
Strategically located manufacturing facility in Goa near Mormugao port, providing logistical efficiencies.
Part of the BLS Group with access to brand recognition and group synergies.
Dedicated in-house product development and quality testing infrastructure with ISO 9001:2015 certification.

risks.title: Segment concentration in wire and cable polymer compounds
risks.detail: Derived 80.93%, 81.59%, and 80.49% of revenue from wire and cable polymer compounds in Fiscals 2026, 2025, and 2024 respectively.

risks.title: Customer concentration risk
risks.detail: Top 10 customers accounted for 66.81%, 64.44%, and 50.52% of revenue in Fiscals 2026, 2025, and 2024 respectively.

risks.title: Outstanding indebtedness
risks.detail: Total fund-based borrowings stood at ₹82.36 crore as on August 31, 2026, and promoter personal guarantees have been extended.

risks.title: Single manufacturing facility operations
risks.detail: Entire manufacturing operations are conducted from a single facility at Goa, exposing business to localized disruptions or shutdowns.

risks.title: Related-party procurement and transactions
risks.detail: Purchased raw materials worth ₹32.35 crore from group entity Vinsul Makardi Limited in Fiscal 2026 (9.26% of revenue).

risks.title: Capacity expansion execution risks
risks.detail: Proposed capex of ₹77.56 crore for expansion of Goa facility has not been appraised by any financial institution.

risks.title: Negative operating cash flows in recent stub period
risks.detail: Generated negative operating cash flow of ₹6.64 crore for the three months ended June 30, 2026.

risks.title: Contingent liabilities risk
risks.detail: Contingent liabilities totaled ₹9.72 crore as of March 31, 2026 (10.24% of net worth), including ₹8.00 crore bank guarantee to IOCL.

notes: Financial data is standalone and covers FY24, FY25, and FY26. Three-month period ended June 30, 2026 stub data is excluded from the financial arrays.
